name: Type 94 Cargo Truck
blurb: A Hangar-only Japanese cargo truck with rolling wheels and steerable front wheels for Leyte logistics scenes.
history: Japanese forces relied on standardized Army cargo trucks to move men and supplies. This model represents the F3-approved Type 94 silhouette; its overall envelope and body details remain explicitly estimated until a primary Japanese drawing is locked.

sources.title: Handbook on Japanese Military Forces, U.S. War Department
